pretreatments.description: Grinding the dried pine needles in an electric blender and sieving the milled samples through a mesh of (20 mesh size)
Autoclaving of pine needles in flask plugged with non-absorbent cotton at 121 °C for 30 min

Repeated exposure of LCB to acid (HCl) and alkali (NaOH) (acid-base-acid treatment) with 30 min cycle, until the wash out liquid was clear, followed by repeated washings with water until neutral pH of the wash out liquid was obtained
